title: Salvaging a second broken board.json overwrites the first board.json.broken
notes: readBoardFile in src/main/board/board-store.ts:452-455 renames a board.json that will not parse to the fixed name board.json.broken. If board.json breaks a second time, the second rename replaces the first damaged copy, and that first copy may be the one that still holds the cards. Fix: pick a name that is not taken yet. Issue: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/207 Review: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/206#discussion_r4467374866
